/.title: Agentic Coding Platform
/.description: Describe an app to an AI agent and get it online with a link you can share. Use the agent built in or bring your own - Claude, Claude Code or anything that speaks MCP. Free, no account, nothing to install.

/build.title: Build an App with AI
/build.description: Say what you want and an AI agent builds it, puts it online and gives you a link to share. Polls, guestbooks, leaderboards and more - free, no account.

/showcase.title: Showcase
/showcase.description: Web apps people built here with an AI agent and chose to show: games, tools, pages and services, running right now. Open any of them in your browser.

/docs.title: How It Works
/docs.description: Write a snippet of C# and whatever it returns is hosted at a public HTTPS address in seconds. The whole platform, in the order you will meet it.

/terms.title: Terms of Service
/terms.description: The rules for using GenHTTP Lambda: what may not be hosted here, how long apps stay online and how abuse is handled.
